_readme: All texts of the study live in this file. Placeholders: {brand} = brand name, {email} = email typed on the sign-in screen, {name} = name typed on the name screen. Simple HTML such as <a> or <strong> is allowed inside texts. Keys starting with _ are comments.

conditions._readme: default_share: true = sharing pre-selected (opt-out), false = not pre-selected (opt-in), null = active choice. In the gain frame switch ON = sharing; in the loss frame ('Do NOT ...') switch ON = NOT sharing. The app works out the switch position for you.

gain.title: Help improve our AI models:
gain.body: Allow the use of your chats and coding sessions to train and improve {brand} AI models. Change anytime in privacy settings.

loss.title: Do NOT help improve our AI models:
loss.body: Do NOT allow the use of your chats and coding sessions to train and improve {brand} AI models. Change anytime in privacy settings.
